label: Bodleian Library MS. Pers. d. 102

metadata.label: Catalogue Description
metadata.value: Full catalogue record in Fihrist: Union Catalogue of Manuscripts from the Islamicate World

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: Persian manuscript of Nizami's poem Lailā and Majnūn, illustrated by Mughal Indian artists.

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: Layout: Written in 4 columns of 21 lines.

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: Binding: European pigskin, with gilt tooling toward edges of inner boards, gilt spine title and label: "MS circa A.D. 1563".
